articles.headline: Most exciting title races, UCL spots in Premier League, LaLiga, Scotland and more
articles.description: Don't look now, but Scotland's top league might be won by a club that hasn't done it since 1960! Bill Connelly breaks down the most exciting races at the top and bottom of Europe's many, many leagues.

images.name: Hearts celebrate SPL 260312 [1296x729]
images.credit: Mark Scates/SNS Group via Getty Images

images.name: Marcotti 'really disappointed' in Guardiola's tactics vs. Real Madrid
images.caption: Gab & Juls react to Man City's 3-0 loss to Real Madrid in the first leg of their round of 16 Champions League clash.

articles.headline: Jürgen Klopp hopes Mohamed Salah stays at Liverpool
articles.description: Former Liverpool manager Jürgen Klopp has said he hopes Mohamed Salah stays at the club, labelling him the best striker they have had in modern times.

images.name: Mohamed Salah and Jurgen Klopp [1296x729]
images.credit: Photo by OLI SCARFF/AFP via Getty Images

images.name: Klopp: I hope Salah stays at Liverpool
images.caption: Jürgen Klopp speaks about his hopes of Mohamed Salah extending his contract at Liverpool.

articles.headline: Salzburg hire Thomas Letsch ahead of Jürgen Klopp arrival
articles.description: RB Salzburg have hired Thomas Letsch as coach as the Austrian club seek a turnaround ahead of the Club World Cup next year and the imminent arrival of Jürgen Klopp as head of soccer for Red Bull's group of clubs.

images.name: Thomas Letsch [1296x729]
images.alt: Thomas Letsch, then of VfL Bochum 1848, looks on ahead of the Bundesliga match between 1. FC KÃ¶ln and VfL Bochum 1848 at RheinEnergieStadion on April 6, 2024 in Cologne, Germany.

articles.headline: Jürgen Klopp: Ex-Liverpool boss takes Red Bull soccer job
articles.description: Former Liverpool manager Jürgen Klopp has signed a contract to become global head of soccer at Red Bull.

images.name: Klopp order of merit [1296x729]
images.alt: Soccer coach Jurgen Klopp receives the Order of Merit of the State of Baden-Warttemberg. Born in Stuttgart, he received the award for his wide-ranging social commitment outside of sport.
images.credit: Bernd WeiÃbrod/picture alliance via Getty Images

images.name: What is Jürgen Klopp's new role at Red Bull?
images.caption: Tom Hamilton explains Jürgen Klopp's new role as global head of soccer at Red Bull from the start of 2025.

articles.headline: Barcelona move for Liverpool's Stefan Bajcetic fails - sources
articles.description: Barcelona failed in a late attempt to sign Stefan Bajčetić with the Liverpool midfielder set to join RB Salzburg on loan, sources have confirmed to ESPN.

images.name: Luis Garcia impressed by Dani Olmo's debut with Barcelona
images.caption: Luis Garcia reacts to Dani Olmo's debut with Barcelona, in which Olmo scored the winning goal for the club.

articles.headline: FC Salzburg's next gen: Gloukh, Gourna-Douath, Konate, more
articles.description: They do it year after year, but who are the next stars in line to emerge from one of the most notorious talent-producing clubs in European football?
